meta.summary: The SDLC quality gates, HITL sign-off and security auditor are all governed by repository-owned code and configuration in the same trust domain as the AI agent they are meant to constrain. Multiple documented guarantees are unenforced or bypassable.

findings.title: Mandatory quality gates can be disabled from repository-owned config
findings.poc: { mode:'project', gates:{ disable:['security'] } } -> 9/10 gates pass, status PASSED
findings.impact: An AI agent with repo write access removes the gate that constrains it and still receives a PASSED certification.
findings.remediation: Make gate enablement immutable at runtime; reject disable/remap of required gates; verify policy hash against a signed baseline.

findings.title: Any gate validator can be remapped to a weaker validator
findings.owasp: A08:2021 Software and Data Integrity Failures
findings.poc: phase 6 + gates.validators.security='scaffold' -> container PASSED, security PASSED; security auditor never runs
findings.impact: The security audit can be replaced by a boundary check while the report still shows a green security gate.
findings.remediation: Remove validator remap from adopter config; allow only a fixed registry of framework-owned validators.

findings.title: Zero evaluated gates reports PASSED
findings.poc: empty artifacts + --allow-missing -> 0 passed, 0 failed, 10 skipped, status PASSED
findings.impact: The CLI prints 'ALL SDLC QUALITY GATES PASSED! Project is ready for production' without evaluating anything.
findings.remediation: Treat skipped required gates as a failure; require at least one evaluated gate per phase; remove --allow-missing from CI usage.

findings.title: Missing mode silently downgrades to self-test
findings.poc: { version: 1 } -> isSelfTest() true; gates validate framework templates instead of project artifacts
findings.impact: A truncated or partially written config turns production enforcement into a self-test that validates shipped templates.
findings.remediation: Require explicit 'mode' and fail closed when absent or invalid; validate config against the JSON schema at runtime.

findings.title: Artifact paths outside the repository are accepted
findings.poc: artifacts.src = <temp dir outside repo> -> resolveGateTargets() accepts it
findings.impact: Gates can be pointed at arbitrary files (including shipped framework templates in node_modules) instead of project artifacts.
findings.remediation: Canonicalize artifact paths and reject anything outside the repository root.

findings.title: Unresolved required globs are silently ignored
findings.poc: artifacts.src = ['examples/order-service/src', 'missing/**'] -> phase 4 PASSED
findings.impact: A typo or deleted directory silently narrows gate coverage without failing the run.
findings.remediation: Fail when any configured pattern resolves to zero files.

findings.title: Config is never validated against its JSON schema at runtime
findings.owasp: A08:2021 Software and Data Integrity Failures
findings.poc: config with unknown top-level key and a security->scaffold remap loads without error
findings.impact: Typos and unsupported overrides are silently accepted, producing a false sense of enforcement.
findings.remediation: Validate with skillforge.config.schema.json before any gate runs; reject unknown keys.

findings.title: Uncommitted working-tree approval satisfies the HITL gate
findings.owasp: A08:2021 Software and Data Integrity Failures
findings.poc: commit a PENDING_REVIEW draft, then edit the file to APPROVED without committing -> PASSED
findings.impact: The document content is read from disk while identity/signature/date checks use the older commit, so the approval is never committed by the human.
findings.remediation: Verify the blob at HEAD (git show) or hash the working-tree content and compare to the committed blob.

findings.title: 'Artifact Hash' is the commit hash and is optional; approval is not bound to artifact content
findings.owasp: A08:2021 Software and Data Integrity Failures
findings.poc: sign off a PRD, then mutate the PRD -> PASSED; omitting the hash field skips the check entirely
findings.impact: An approval can authorize a PRD/architecture document that was never reviewed.
findings.remediation: Require a path plus SHA-256 of each approved artifact and verify it at gate time; make the field mandatory.

findings.title: Signing key UID is not checked; author email is self-asserted
findings.poc: commit signed by attacker key with author.email=human@corp.com -> %G?='G' and PASSED
findings.impact: Any agent with its own GPG key and a spoofed git author email can impersonate an allow-listed reviewer.
findings.remediation: Compare the signing key fingerprint/UID (%GF/%GS) to the allow-listed reviewer key, not the author email string.

findings.title: TTL uses the forgeable committer date, not the approval date
findings.owasp: A08:2021 Software and Data Integrity Failures
findings.poc: Approval Date 2020-01-01 + GIT_COMMITTER_DATE=now + signoffTtlDays=30 -> PASSED
findings.impact: Expired approvals can be revived indefinitely by rewriting the committer date.
findings.remediation: Use the human Approval Date from the signed document (or the author date) and bind it to a freshness attestation.

findings.title: Agent identity denylist misses common coding agents
findings.poc: cursor, devin, aider, gemini, codex, anthropic assistant identities -> isAgentIdentity() false
findings.impact: An automated committer whose identity is not on the short pattern list is treated as a human reviewer.
findings.remediation: Use an allow-list of reviewer key fingerprints; treat everything else as automated.

findings.title: Sign-off parsing is not fence-aware
findings.poc: authorization checkbox placed inside a fenced code block -> PASSED
findings.impact: Structural tokens anywhere in the raw document (fences, quotes, examples) satisfy the approval gate.
findings.remediation: Reuse the fence-aware markdown parser and read fields only from the document header.

findings.title: Self-test attestations are indistinguishable from production approvals
findings.poc: self-test mode returns passed=true with only a human-readable warning
findings.impact: Downstream tools see passed=true and cannot tell the verdict is a demo attestation.
findings.remediation: Return a structured verdict (mode, demo, artifact hash, signer fingerprint) and refuse production authorization in demo mode.

findings.title: SEC-004 hardcoded-credential rule can never match
findings.poc: password = 'S3cr3tP@ssw0rd' -> no SEC-004 finding
findings.impact: The primary hardcoded-secret detector is dead because the negative lookahead contains \s*, which matches the empty string.
findings.remediation: Remove the empty-matching alternative; add a positive-fixture liveness test for every rule.

findings.title: Secret scanning skips every comment line
findings.poc: # AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE in .env -> not reported
findings.impact: Secrets committed in comments, YAML headers, or .env files are invisible to the audit.
findings.remediation: Scan .env/YAML regardless of comment marker; only skip comments for code extensions, and support inline suppression.

findings.title: Multi-line CORS-with-credentials rule is dead in line-based scanning
findings.poc: prettier-formatted origin '*' / credentials: true on separate lines -> no SEC-014 finding
findings.impact: The most common formatting of a critical misconfiguration evades detection.
findings.remediation: Scan multi-line windows (or the parsed config) instead of individual lines.

findings.title: Build output directories are excluded from scanning
findings.poc: eval() in dist/bundle.js -> zero files scanned
findings.impact: Vulnerable code that is actually shipped in build artifacts is never audited.
findings.remediation: Scan build outputs or explicitly document them as out of scope per project policy.

findings.title: MEDIUM weaknesses never block the gate
findings.poc: MD5 password hashing -> gate PASSED (warning only); CI does not pass --strict
findings.impact: Weak cryptography and insecure randomness are reported but do not stop the pipeline.
findings.remediation: Define per-severity blocking policy in framework-owned config and enforce it in CI.

findings.title: --diff mode excludes untracked files
findings.poc: new untracked leaked.ts with an AWS key -> 0 findings in --diff mode
findings.impact: Pre-commit scans miss exactly the newly added files most likely to contain leaked credentials.
findings.remediation: Use git status --porcelain or diff HEAD plus untracked files.

findings.title: The Phase 5 test gate never executes tests
findings.poc: it(...) with assert.equal(1,2) -> gate PASSED
findings.impact: Failing test suites are certified because the gate only counts test/assertion syntax.
findings.remediation: Run the project test command and use the real exit code; treat syntax counts as an additional check.

findings.title: Skip-only suites satisfy the test gate
findings.poc: it.skip(...) containing an assertion -> gate PASSED
findings.impact: Disabling tests by adding .skip keeps the quality gate green.
findings.remediation: Require a minimum count of executed (not declared) tests.

findings.title: Missing requirement-ID citations only warn
findings.poc: tests with assertions but no FR-/EC- reference -> gate PASSED
findings.impact: AGENTS.md rule 3 (traceability) is not enforced by the gate that is supposed to enforce it.
findings.remediation: Fail when no requirement citation is present.

findings.title: PRD gate is structural theatre
findings.poc: headings + 'None.' + 'FR-001' + the words 'Given When Then' -> PASSED
findings.impact: An empty PRD satisfies the Phase 2 gate, so agents can proceed without requirements.
findings.remediation: Require minimum content, scenario structure, and cross-reference integrity (FR -> AC -> test).

findings.title: Empty Mermaid fences count as diagrams
findings.poc: two empty ```mermaid blocks -> architecture gate PASSED
findings.impact: The C4 diagram requirement is satisfied by empty code fences.
findings.remediation: Require non-empty diagram bodies and parse/validate the Mermaid graph.

findings.title: Missing ADR index only warns
findings.poc: ADR section with 'Pending.' -> architecture gate PASSED
findings.impact: Architecture decisions can be entirely undocumented while the gate passes.
findings.remediation: Fail when no ADR references or ADR files exist.

remediationStatus.note: ADR absence is a Phase 3 warning.

findings.title: get_skill_instructions allows path traversal
findings.poc: skillName='../secret' reads .agents/secret/SKILL.md
findings.impact: A prompt-injected agent can read arbitrary SKILL.md-named files outside the skills directory.
findings.remediation: Validate skillName against ^[a-z0-9-]+$ and verify the resolved path stays under .agents/skills.

findings.title: audit_security scans arbitrary absolute paths
findings.poc: audit_security({ path: '<outside workspace>' }) returns findings and snippets from that path
findings.impact: The tool can be used as a file-content oracle to exfiltrate data outside the workspace via prompt injection.
findings.remediation: Confine path to the workspace root and reject absolute/escaping paths.

findings.title: run_quality_gate certifies production using self-test fixtures
findings.poc: run_quality_gate() -> 'ALL SDLC QUALITY GATES PASSED! Project is ready for production.' in self-test mode
findings.impact: An agent can obtain a production-ready verdict without project artifacts, then report it to the user.
findings.remediation: Return structured mode/verdict data and never emit a production-ready claim from self-test.

findings.title: CI gate executes the pull request's own gate implementation
findings.owasp: A08:2021 Software and Data Integrity Failures
findings.poc: a PR editing src/core/gate-runner.mjs (or skillforge.config.json) is graded by that edited code
findings.impact: Self-grading: the PR can make its own quality gate return PASSED.
findings.remediation: Run gates from an immutable, pinned version (separate workflow from the default branch or a published package) and guard protected paths.

findings.title: Third-party actions are pinned to mutable tags
findings.owasp: A08:2021 Software and Data Integrity Failures
findings.poc: 8 uses: references are tag-pinned, not SHA-pinned
findings.impact: A compromised or retagged action executes with repository credentials.
findings.remediation: Pin every action to a full 40-character commit SHA and update via Dependabot.

findings.title: npm ci runs dependency lifecycle scripts
findings.owasp: A08:2021 Software and Data Integrity Failures
findings.poc: a PR modifies package-lock.json to add a package with a postinstall script -> executes in CI
findings.impact: Arbitrary code execution on the runner via lockfile tampering.
findings.remediation: Use npm ci --ignore-scripts and add a separate, reviewed install step only where builds require it.

findings.title: actions/checkout persists credentials while PR code runs
findings.poc: persist-credentials is not set to false; later steps run PR-controlled node code
findings.impact: PR code can read the persisted token from .git/config and use it against the API.
findings.remediation: Set persist-credentials: false on every checkout that precedes untrusted execution.

findings.title: A job with pull-requests: write executes untrusted code
findings.poc: evaluate-sdlc-gates has pull-requests: write and runs npm ci + node bin/skillforge.mjs
findings.impact: Same-repository PR branches (the normal agent workflow) run with a write-capable token available to the job.
findings.remediation: Split evaluation (read-only) from commenting (write-only, no code execution).

findings.title: Gate workflow has no top-level least-privilege permissions
findings.poc: only job-level permissions are declared; ci.yml declares top-level contents: read
findings.impact: Workflow-level token scope falls back to repository defaults.
findings.remediation: Declare permissions: {} at workflow level and grant the minimum per job.

findings.title: Gate, diff, and scorecard failures are masked with '|| true'
findings.poc: node bin/skillforge.mjs gate --out gate-report.json || true
findings.impact: A crashed or errored gate run is indistinguishable from a clean run and only fails later if the report is missing.
findings.remediation: Let the command exit status fail the step; handle missing reports explicitly.

findings.title: No automated dependency updates
findings.poc: no dependabot.yml or renovate config
findings.impact: Vulnerable actions/dependencies (see SFA-061, dependency snapshot) are not remediated automatically.
findings.remediation: Add Dependabot for npm and github-actions with a short review SLA.

findings.title: CI has no dependency vulnerability review
findings.poc: npm audit reports 13 vulnerabilities (9 high) but no CI step fails on them
findings.impact: Known vulnerable dependencies can be merged indefinitely.
findings.remediation: Add actions/dependency-review-action or npm audit --audit-level=high as a required check.

findings.title: No CODEOWNERS protection for the enforcement code
findings.poc: no .github/CODEOWNERS or root CODEOWNERS
findings.impact: Without branch-protection verification, PRs can edit src/core, workflows, and the gate config without a human reviewer.
findings.remediation: Add CODEOWNERS for src/core, bin, .github/workflows, .agents, and skillforge.config.json; require review and protect the branch.

findings.title: CI builds PR-controlled MSBuild projects
findings.owasp: A08:2021 Software and Data Integrity Failures
findings.poc: dotnet run --project examples/dotnet-order-service/tests/OrderService.Tests/OrderService.Tests.csproj
findings.impact: MSBuild targets, analyzers, and package imports from the PR execute on the runner.
findings.remediation: Run .NET tests in a sandboxed job with read-only token and no secrets; pin SDK and analyzers.

remediationStatus.note: .NET tests run in a read-only, secret-free job; MSBuild execution remains a documented trust assumption.

findings.title: No pull_request_target workflow
findings.poc: guard test passes
findings.impact: Currently safe; keep it that way.
findings.remediation: Add a regression check to prevent introducing pull_request_target with a head checkout.

vulnerabilities.scope: all reported advisories are in the dev toolchain (eslint / typescript-eslint / c8 / glob / picomatch / fdir / tinyglobby); no vulnerable production dependency was reported

unverifiableFromRepository: Branch protection rules and required status checks
Whether the gate workflow is a required check before merge
